description: This is a section drawing titled "Diagram 2 Chimneys and flues". It shows one chimney in section: grey masonry on either side, labelled "Chimney", with the flue running up between them, lined ("Flue liner"); the label "Flue" points to the passage. Near the base of the flue is a small "Soot door", with the "Debris collection space" beside it. A diagonal "Fluepipe" enters the chimney through a "Sleeve" in its right-hand side. The fluepipe runs down at an angle and then vertically, and two circular openings in it are indicated by leader lines as "Possible positions for access". The lower end of the fluepipe terminates at the top of a square box labelled "Appliance", joined by a collar labelled "Appliance flue outlet". Leader lines link each label to its corresponding part, and the grey shading distinguishes the masonry and liner from the open flue and pipe spaces.
